Customers say Customers find this overdrive pedal performs well as a blues driver alternative, with smooth and responsive controls and a well-built construction. The sound quality receives positive feedback, with one customer noting it sounds like a tube amp, while another mentions the tone control range goes from dark and murky to spiky and bright. Customers appreciate the pedal's dynamics, with one noting it responds well to playing dynamics, and another highlighting its tube feel emulation.
